source.version: Part 17 — Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation — Batch 02
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-326–330 add cleaning-versus-disinfection process logic, contact-time and surface-preparation controls, irrigation-system hygiene, greenhouse pest exclusion, and environmental disease prevention. Public wording separates cleaning from microbial inactivation, waterborne detection from disease causation, screening from ventilation performance, and environmental disease pressure from unsupported universal Cannabis RH/VPD/temperature or airflow setpoints. Regulated disinfectant and pesticide use remains governed by current labels and jurisdictional requirements.
source.note: This batch advances controlled Volume 17 with sanitation-process validation, irrigation hygiene, structural exclusion, and evidence-bounded environmental disease prevention.
